label: SIMULATED GPS - never measured on any vehicle or receiver
true_track: east at 10.0 m/s, straight, constant altitude

phases.name: NOMINAL
phases.description: reported track = true track; 3D fix, 10 satellites, healthy estimator

phases.name: SLOW_DRIFT
phases.description: reported position drifts north at 1 m/s; velocity stays truthful
phases.expected: no alert: below the documented ~4 m/s floor with ML off (known limitation)

phases.name: FAST_DRIFT
phases.description: the drift accelerates to 6 m/s; velocity stays truthful

phases.name: SUDDEN_JUMP
phases.description: reported position jumps a further 200 m east, then holds that offset
phases.expected: GPS_SPOOFING at the jump; the held offset is forgotten within the residual window (known limitation)

phases.name: GNSS_LOSS
phases.description: offset removed (return jump); GPS_RAW_INT reports fix_type 1, 3 satellites
phases.expected: GPS_SPOOFING at the return jump, then DOS 'GNSS fix lost'

phases.name: RECOVERY
phases.description: 3D fix, 10 satellites, reported track = true track
phases.expected: alerts stop and the threat clears
